verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves the prior blocker. The fix lane now seals the model's exact commit before the hostile gate, uploads the bundle before target-controlled code runs, and moves the contents/workflows-capable push into a fresh publisher job. No token-bearing step follows the gate in the run job. The publisher binds the fetched object to the pre-gate SHA, dispatched parent (and recorded merge parent where applicable), bot identity, .beads policy, live head, and an atomic force-with-lease before pushing. Outcome recording and lease release wait for publication, while skipped or refused publication remains fail-closed as pushed=false. The tests exercise the real poisoning primitive, verify zero post-gate token steps non-vacuously, cover artifact substitution and malformed inputs, preserve the gate-visible worktree/index, and test the push lease end to end. No reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
